about: docs/adr/0037 amendment 6: the rests of core/Scenes/jetrover-bench.json, written by SceneRestTests (just gen-isaac-goldens). objects: name, then per rest 0-5 its extents (x, y, up), footprint radius and whether a layout may lay it there. poses: index, rest, x, y, yaw, then PoseAt's x, y, z, qw, qx, qy, qz. restOf: qw, qx, qy, qz, then RestOf's rest and yaw. fits: index, rest, x, y, FitsOnTable. overlaps: a, x, y, rest, b, x, y, rest, Overlaps.
